posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Final: Guardians 9, White Sox 5 There will be a Game 5 on Saturday in Cleveland for all the marbles, and a date in the ALCS with the Rays.

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: There goes that man again. An RBI infield single by José Ramírez pushes it to a 6-4 Guardians lead.
posts.jp: **あの男がやった。ホセ・ラミレスの適時内野安打でガーディアンズが6-4にリード🔥**

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Robert Gasser is likely to start in another hostile environment when the NLCS goes to Dodger Stadium. The advice he got the night before NLDS G4 will come in handy. “You’re going to have 50,000 people rooting against you tomorrow. Don’t give them one more. Root for yourself.”
posts.jp: **Robert Gasserはリーグ優勝決定シリーズがドジャース・スタジアムに移った時、また敵地での先発になるだろう。地区シリーズ第4戦の前夜にもらったアドバイスが役に立つ。「明日は5万人がお前に反対票を投じる。奴らをガッカリさせるな。自分を応援しろ」**
